heading: Hey!! I'm Cadhla
bio:
I studied Fine Art and used to paint, so composition, placement and the overall feel of an image really matter to me. I bring that way of seeing into every edit.

Before going freelance I worked with creative agencies, leading video projects from concept to final edit for clients including Westfield and Sculpted by Aimee. Now I focus on short-form editing for creators who treat their content as a business and want it to look like them.

My approach is idea-led. I'd rather your videos connect and mean something than chase attention for the sake of it.
